lines.text: Two prostitutes came before the king, and one said the other woman had a baby three days after her.
One woman said the other's son died because she rolled over him, and she swapped the babies while she slept.
The two women argued before the king, and he called for a spear.
The king ordered the living child cut in two, then gave the baby to the woman who begged for him.
When all Israel heard the judgment, they stood in awe, seeing the wrath of God in the king.
